sloka: इति रामस्य मातुश्च सुमित्रायाश्च सन्निधौ ।राजा दशरथः शोचन् जीवित अन्तम् उपागमत् ॥२-६४-७८॥
transliteration: iti rāmasya mātuśca sumitrāyāśca sannidhau ।rājā daśarathaḥ śocan jīvita antam upāgamat ॥2-64-78॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha, thus crying in distress in the presence of Rama's mother and Sumitra reached the end of his life.
